files.rationale: Kept both additions: initializeSettings now restores the saved language (PR A) and the chirp-on-done toggle state (PR B), and both the language-select change listener and the chirp-on-done toggle change listener are registered before initializeSettings runs.

The settings dialog now has the PR A language selector and the PR B 'Chirp on done' toggle as separate settings options, with the dark-theme toggle left first so applyTranslations' '.toggle-label' lookup still targets it.
